object.body:
Dear ${__recipient.name},

Your request for the ${requestedObjectName} entitlement has been assigned

This entitlement requires activation before each use. To activate this entitlement, visit MySailPoint > Launchpad > Just-In-Time Access

#if ($removeDate)

Your access to ${requestedObjectName} is scheduled to end on ${removeDate}.

#end

Thanks,
The ${__global.productName} Team
object.description: Sent to the identity who made an access request that was automatically approved and assigned.
object.name: Just-In-Time Access Request Assignment
object.subject: Your access request for ${requestedObjectName} has been assigned
